definitions.explanation: Kansai dialect equivalent of そうだ (sou da), used to express agreement or affirmation.

examples.japanese: 「{今日|きょう}は{金曜日|きんようび}やろ？」「せや」
せやな、その{通|とお}りや。
せやせや、{忘|わす}れてた。

notes:
DIALECT:
Kansai ({関西|かんさい}) dialect, widely used throughout the region including Osaka, Kyoto, and Kobe.

STANDARD EQUIVALENT:
そう / そうだ (standard Japanese)

DERIVED FORMS:
・せやな - that's right, isn't it
・せやで - it is, you know
・せやから - that's why
・せやけど - but, however
・せやろ - right? (seeking confirmation)
・せやせや - yes yes, that's right

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
・ほんま - really (Kansai)
・そうや - that's right (variant)

USAGE:
Very common in everyday Kansai speech. Often heard in comedy shows and Osaka-based media.
